name: Docling Components

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docling-components/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docling-components.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docling-components/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docling-components.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docling-components
    steps:
      # Dependabot runs have no access to Actions secrets, so skip the app
      # token there and fall back to the (read-only) default token.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        id: app-token
        if: github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.CI_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.CI_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          # Check out the actual branch head so we're not in detached HEAD state.
          # github.head_ref is set on pull_request events; github.ref_name on push.
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docling-components/package-lock.json

      - run: npm ci

      # Install only the Chromium browser used by Playwright (no system deps
      # needed for the headless shell on ubuntu-latest).
      - run: npx playwright install chromium

      # Generate any missing linux baselines in tests/snapshots-ci/ and
      # commit them back to the branch. On the very first push of a new test
      # (or after intentional component changes) this writes the ground-truth;
      # on all subsequent runs the directory is already populated so nothing
      # is committed and the check step does strict comparison.
      - name: Generate missing visual baselines
        run: |
          npm run build
          npx playwright test --project=local tests/e2e/visual.test.ts --update-snapshots
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Commit new baselines (if any)
        if: github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add docling-components/tests/snapshots-ci/
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -s -m "test: update visual baselines [skip ci]"
          git push origin HEAD

      # format, lint, typecheck, build, publint, attw, vitest unit tests,
      # and Playwright e2e + visual regression (including CDN project) —
      # The CDN tests intercept unpkg requests and serve the local dist build,
      # so no published release is required.
      - run: npm run check

      # Upload the Playwright HTML report and any diff screenshots as
      # artifacts so failures can be inspected without re-running locally.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            docling-components/playwright-report/
            docling-components/test-results/
          retention-days: 14

name: Docling Core

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docling-core/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docling-core.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docling-core/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docling-core.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docling-core
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docling-core/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run check

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Docling Components — CDN</title>
    <!--
      This fixture loads the component from the published CDN package.
      The version is injected at test time via the CDN_VERSION env var
      (default: "latest").  In CI this is set to the version under test
      so the CDN integration test validates the published artefact.
    -->
    <script type="module">
      const version =
        new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('version') ?? 'latest';
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.type = 'module';
      script.src = `https://unpkg.com/@docling/docling-components@${version}`;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <docling-img
      id="img"
      src="/docling-components/tests/fixtures/document.json"
    ></docling-img>
    <docling-table
      id="table"
      src="/docling-components/tests/fixtures/document.json"
      items="#/tables/0"
    ></docling-table>
  </body>
</html>

name: Sync upstream docling-core

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *' # Every day at 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_version:
        description: 'Specific docling-core release version/tag (e.g., v2.18.0) - leave blank for latest'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  check-and-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Generate GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Checkout docling-ts
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      - name: Get Target docling-core Version
        id: version_check
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}"
          else
            echo "Fetching latest release from docling-project/docling-core..."
            TAG=$(curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
              https://api.github.com/repos/docling-project/docling-core/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          fi

          if [ -z "$TAG" ] || [ "$TAG" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Error: Could not retrieve release tag."
            exit 1
          fi

          CLEAN_VERSION="${TAG#v}"
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "version=$CLEAN_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Current version configured in docling-ts/docling-core/package.json
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r '.version // empty' docling-core/package.json)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "Target version: $CLEAN_VERSION (tag: $TAG)"
          echo "Current version in docling-core package.json: $CURRENT_VERSION"

          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            echo "should_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Manual target_version provided ($TAG). Forcing update."
          else
            # Extract major and minor numbers for comparison (e.g., 2.18.0 -> 2 and 18)
            TARGET_MAJOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1)
            TARGET_MINOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f2)
            CURRENT_MAJOR=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1)
            CURRENT_MINOR=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | cut -d. -f2)

            # Default empty values to 0
            TARGET_MAJOR=${TARGET_MAJOR:-0}
            TARGET_MINOR=${TARGET_MINOR:-0}
            CURRENT_MAJOR=${CURRENT_MAJOR:-0}
            CURRENT_MINOR=${CURRENT_MINOR:-0}

            if [ "$TARGET_MAJOR" -gt "$CURRENT_MAJOR" ] || { [ "$TARGET_MAJOR" -eq "$CURRENT_MAJOR" ] && [ "$TARGET_MINOR" -gt "$CURRENT_MINOR" ]; }; then
              echo "should_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "Newer major/minor docling-core found ($CLEAN_VERSION > $CURRENT_VERSION). Triggering sync."
            else
              echo "should_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "docling-core major.minor ($TARGET_MAJOR.$TARGET_MINOR) is not greater than current ($CURRENT_MAJOR.$CURRENT_MINOR). Skipping sync."
            fi
          fi

      - name: Check for existing open PR
        id: pr_check
        if: steps.version_check.outputs.should_update == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="sync/docling-core-${VERSION}"
          # A manual dispatch always forces a sync; otherwise skip if a PR is already open
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            echo "should_sync=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
            if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
              echo "Open PR #${EXISTING_PR} already exists for branch ${BRANCH_NAME}. Skipping sync."
              echo "should_sync=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "should_sync=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          fi

      - name: Checkout upstream docling-core repository
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: docling-project/docling-core
          ref: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          path: upstream-docling-core

      - name: Set up Node.js
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docling-core/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Bob Shell
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: curl -fsSL https://bob.ibm.com/download/bobshell.sh | bash -s -- --pm npm

      - name: Install docling-core dependencies
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: cd docling-core && npm ci

      - name: Run Bob CLI to update TypeScript models and tests
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        env:
          BOB_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOB_API_KEY }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          bob run --accept-license --mode agent --trust --max-turns 1000 \
            "You are updating the TypeScript package in the 'docling-core/' subdirectory to match the Python implementation in 'upstream-docling-core/docling_core/'.
            Target release version: $TAG (upgrading from the current version in docling-core/package.json).

            Please perform the following tasks:
            1. Inspect the Python codebase in upstream-docling-core/docling_core/ (especially docling_core/types/ and document hierarchy/traversal logic).
            2. Update docling-core/src/types/models.ts to reflect all updated/new models, fields, and types.
            3. Update docling-core/src/types/typing.ts to add or adjust type predicates and discriminators (e.g. isDoclingDocItem, isDoclingAnnotation, isDocling).
            4. Inspect and update remaining code under docling-core/src/ (e.g. docling-core/src/index.ts, iterateDocumentItems, resolveDocumentItem, etc.) for any corresponding changes or new features from the Python repository.
            5. Update docling-core/tests/ to add tests for any new or modified types and functions.
            6. Run 'cd docling-core && npm run check' to verify formatting, linting, type-checking, tests, build, and publint pass without errors. Fix any issues found.
            7. Write a file named 'pr-body.md' in the current working directory summarising every change you made. For each changed or added TypeScript construct (type, interface, function, constant), include a bullet point that names the TS symbol, describes what changed, and contains a Markdown link directly to the Python source that motivated the change using the URL pattern: https://github.com/docling-project/docling-core/blob/$TAG/<relative-path-inside-upstream-docling-core>#L<line> (e.g. https://github.com/docling-project/docling-core/blob/$TAG/docling_core/types/doc/document.py#L42). Use the actual file path and line number from 'upstream-docling-core/' that contains the relevant Python class, field, or function. Group bullets under headings matching the TS file that was changed (e.g. '### models.ts', '### typing.ts', '### index.ts').
            8. Write a file named 'pr-comments.json' in the current working directory. It must be a valid JSON array where each element describes one inline review comment to post on the PR diff. Only include entries for lines you actually added or modified (i.e. lines that will appear on the RIGHT side of the diff). Each element must have exactly these fields:
               - \"path\": the file path relative to the repo root (e.g. \"docling-core/src/types/models.ts\")
               - \"line\": the line number in the new version of that file where the change appears (integer, 1-based)
               - \"body\": a short Markdown comment (1-3 sentences) that explains why the change was made and links to the Python source with the URL pattern above.
               Use the actual line numbers from the files you just wrote/modified. Example element: {\"path\": \"docling-core/src/types/models.ts\", \"line\": 87, \"body\": \"Added \\\"heatmap\\\" to PictureClassificationLabel to match the Python enum. [Source](https://github.com/docling-project/docling-core/blob/$TAG/docling_core/types/doc/document.py#L87)\"}

            Rules:
            - Do not modify package.json or package-lock.json.
            - Limit the number of searches that you do and focus on the (entire) files that contain the model and traversal code."

      - name: Remove upstream checkout before commit
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: rm -rf upstream-docling-core

      - name: Commit and push changes
        id: commit
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="sync/docling-core-${VERSION}"

          git config user.name "${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}[bot]"
          git config user.email "${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME"
          git add docling-core/

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected after running Bob CLI."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "feat(docling-core): sync types with docling-core ${TAG}"
          git push -u origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

          echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update pull request
        id: pr_create
        if: steps.commit.outputs.branch_name != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="${{ steps.commit.outputs.branch_name }}"

          HEADER=$(cat <<EOF
          ## Automated Upstream Sync: docling-core [${TAG}](https://github.com/docling-project/docling-core/releases/tag/${TAG})

          This pull request was generated automatically using **IBM Bob CLI** in GitHub Actions.

          EOF
          )

          # Use Bob-generated pr-body.md when available, otherwise fall back to a generic body.
          if [ -f pr-body.md ]; then
            PR_BODY="${HEADER}$(cat pr-body.md)"
          else
            PR_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
          ${HEADER}
          ### Actions Taken:
          - Analyzed Python schemas and logic in upstream release \`${TAG}\`.
          - Updated TypeScript interfaces in \`docling-core/src/types/models.ts\`.
          - Updated type predicates in \`docling-core/src/types/typing.ts\`.
          - Updated traversal & utility logic in \`docling-core/src/index.ts\`.
          - Updated and verified test suite (\`npm run check\`).
          EOF
            )
          fi

          EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$EXISTING_PR" --title "feat(docling-core): update types for docling-core ${TAG}" --body "$PR_BODY"
            echo "pr_number=$EXISTING_PR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
              --base main \
              --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
              --title "feat(docling-core): update types for docling-core ${TAG}" \
              --body "$PR_BODY")
            echo "pr_number=$(echo "$PR_URL" | grep -oE '[0-9]+$')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post inline review comments on pull request diff
        if: steps.pr_create.outputs.pr_number != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ steps.pr_create.outputs.pr_number }}"

          if [ ! -f pr-comments.json ]; then
            echo "pr-comments.json not found — skipping inline comments."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Fetch the latest commit SHA on the PR branch (required by the API)
          COMMIT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.head.sha')

          # Post each comment via the GitHub REST API
          jq -c '.[]' pr-comments.json | while IFS= read -r comment; do
            PATH_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.path')
            LINE_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.line')
            BODY_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.body')

            gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              --method POST \
              --field commit_id="$COMMIT_ID" \
              --field path="$PATH_VAL" \
              --field line="$LINE_VAL" \
              --field side="RIGHT" \
              --field body="$BODY_VAL" \
              || echo "Warning: failed to post comment on $PATH_VAL:$LINE_VAL"
          done

name: Sync upstream docling-client

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *' # Every day at 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_version:
        description: 'Specific docling release version/tag (e.g., v2.115.0) - leave blank for latest'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  check-and-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Generate GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Checkout docling-ts
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      - name: Get Target docling Version
        id: version_check
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}"
          else
            echo "Fetching latest release from docling-project/docling..."
            TAG=$(curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
              https://api.github.com/repos/docling-project/docling/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          fi

          if [ -z "$TAG" ] || [ "$TAG" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Error: Could not retrieve release tag."
            exit 1
          fi

          CLEAN_VERSION="${TAG#v}"
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "version=$CLEAN_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Current Python docling version documented in PYTHON_CLIENT_PARITY.md (e.g., "Docling Python 2.115.0")
          PARITY_FILE="docling-client/PYTHON_CLIENT_PARITY.md"
          if [ -f "$PARITY_FILE" ]; then
            CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION=$(grep -oE 'Docling Python [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$PARITY_FILE" | head -n1 | awk '{print $3}')
          fi
          CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION=${CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION:-"0.0.0"}
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "Target docling version: $CLEAN_VERSION (tag: $TAG)"
          echo "Current synced docling version: $CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION"

          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            echo "should_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Manual target_version provided ($TAG). Forcing update."
          else
            # Extract major and minor numbers for comparison (e.g., 2.115.0 -> 2 and 115)
            TARGET_MAJOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1)
            TARGET_MINOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f2)
            CURRENT_MAJOR=$(echo "$CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1)
            CURRENT_MINOR=$(echo "$CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION" | cut -d. -f2)

            # Default empty values to 0
            TARGET_MAJOR=${TARGET_MAJOR:-0}
            TARGET_MINOR=${TARGET_MINOR:-0}
            CURRENT_MAJOR=${CURRENT_MAJOR:-0}
            CURRENT_MINOR=${CURRENT_MINOR:-0}

            if [ "$TARGET_MAJOR" -gt "$CURRENT_MAJOR" ] || { [ "$TARGET_MAJOR" -eq "$CURRENT_MAJOR" ] && [ "$TARGET_MINOR" -gt "$CURRENT_MINOR" ]; }; then
              echo "should_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "Newer major/minor docling found ($CLEAN_VERSION > $CURRENT_DOCLING_VERSION). Triggering sync."
            else
              echo "should_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "docling major.minor ($TARGET_MAJOR.$TARGET_MINOR) is not greater than current ($CURRENT_MAJOR.$CURRENT_MINOR). Skipping sync."
            fi
          fi

      - name: Check for existing open PR
        id: pr_check
        if: steps.version_check.outputs.should_update == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="sync/docling-client-${VERSION}"
          # A manual dispatch always forces a sync; otherwise skip if a PR is already open
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_version }}" ]; then
            echo "should_sync=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
            if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
              echo "Open PR #${EXISTING_PR} already exists for branch ${BRANCH_NAME}. Skipping sync."
              echo "should_sync=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "should_sync=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          fi

      - name: Checkout upstream docling repository
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: docling-project/docling
          ref: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          path: upstream-docling

      - name: Set up Node.js
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docling-client/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Bob Shell
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: curl -fsSL https://bob.ibm.com/download/bobshell.sh | bash -s -- --pm npm

      - name: Install docling-client dependencies
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: cd docling-client && npm ci

      - name: Run Bob CLI to update TypeScript client, types, parity docs, and tests
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        env:
          BOB_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOB_API_KEY }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          UPSTREAM_SHA=$(cd upstream-docling && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          bob run --accept-license --mode agent --trust --max-turns 1000 \
            "You are updating the TypeScript package in the 'docling-client/' subdirectory to match the Python service client implementation in 'upstream-docling/docling/service_client/' and relevant service datamodels in 'upstream-docling/docling/datamodel/service/'.
            Target docling release version: $TAG (commit $UPSTREAM_SHA).

            Please perform the following tasks:
            1. Inspect the Python service client codebase in 'upstream-docling/docling/service_client/' and service models in 'upstream-docling/docling/datamodel/service/'.
            2. Update docling-client/src/types.ts to reflect all updated/new models, options, enums, parameters, and types.
            3. Update docling-client/src/ (client.ts, transport.ts, watchers.ts, scheduler.ts, sources.ts, artifacts.ts, errors.ts, index.ts) for any corresponding changes, new client options, methods, or behavior from the Python service client.
            4. Update docling-client/PYTHON_CLIENT_PARITY.md to reference Docling Python $VERSION at commit $UPSTREAM_SHA, updating parity tables and documented behavior where applicable.
            5. Update docling-client/test/ (client.test.ts, transport.test.ts, watchers.test.ts, artifacts.test.ts, type-parity.ts) to add or update tests for any new or modified features and types.
            6. Run 'cd docling-client && npm run check' to verify formatting, linting, type-checking, tests, build, publint, and attw pass without errors. Fix any issues found.
            7. Write a file named 'pr-body.md' in the current working directory summarising every change you made. For each changed or added TypeScript construct (type, interface, class, method, function, constant), include a bullet point that names the TS symbol, describes what changed, and contains a Markdown link directly to the Python source that motivated the change using the URL pattern: https://github.com/docling-project/docling/blob/$TAG/<relative-path-inside-upstream-docling>#L<line> (e.g. https://github.com/docling-project/docling/blob/$TAG/docling/service_client/client.py#L42). Use the actual file path and line number from 'upstream-docling/' that contains the relevant Python class, field, or function. Group bullets under headings matching the TS file that was changed (e.g. '### types.ts', '### client.ts', '### PYTHON_CLIENT_PARITY.md').
            8. Write a file named 'pr-comments.json' in the current working directory. It must be a valid JSON array where each element describes one inline review comment to post on the PR diff. Only include entries for lines you actually added or modified (i.e. lines that will appear on the RIGHT side of the diff). Each element must have exactly these fields:
               - \"path\": the file path relative to the repo root (e.g. \"docling-client/src/types.ts\")
               - \"line\": the line number in the new version of that file where the change appears (integer, 1-based)
               - \"body\": a short Markdown comment (1-3 sentences) that explains why the change was made and links to the Python source with the URL pattern above.
               Use the actual line numbers from the files you just wrote/modified. Example element: {\"path\": \"docling-client/src/types.ts\", \"line\": 87, \"body\": \"Added new conversion option to match Python ConvertDocumentsOptions. [Source](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/blob/$TAG/docling/datamodel/service/options.py#L87)\"}

            Rules:
            - Do not modify package.json or package-lock.json.
            - Limit the number of searches that you do and focus on the files that contain the service client and service datamodels."

      - name: Remove upstream checkout before commit
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        run: rm -rf upstream-docling

      - name: Commit and push changes
        id: commit
        if: steps.pr_check.outputs.should_sync == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="sync/docling-client-${VERSION}"

          git config user.name "${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}[bot]"
          git config user.email "${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME"
          git add docling-client/

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected after running Bob CLI."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "feat(docling-client): sync client with docling ${TAG}"
          git push -u origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

          echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update pull request
        id: pr_create
        if: steps.commit.outputs.branch_name != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version_check.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="${{ steps.commit.outputs.branch_name }}"

          HEADER=$(cat <<EOF
          ## Automated Upstream Sync: docling [${TAG}](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/releases/tag/${TAG})

          This pull request was generated automatically using **IBM Bob CLI** in GitHub Actions.

          EOF
          )

          # Use Bob-generated pr-body.md when available, otherwise fall back to a generic body.
          if [ -f pr-body.md ]; then
            PR_BODY="${HEADER}$(cat pr-body.md)"
          else
            PR_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
          ${HEADER}
          ### Actions Taken:
          - Analyzed Python service client and datamodels in upstream release \`${TAG}\`.
          - Updated TypeScript interfaces and types in \`docling-client/src/types.ts\`.
          - Updated client implementation in \`docling-client/src/\`.
          - Updated \`docling-client/PYTHON_CLIENT_PARITY.md\`.
          - Updated and verified test suite (\`npm run check\`).
          EOF
            )
          fi

          EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$EXISTING_PR" --title "feat(docling-client): sync client with docling ${TAG}" --body "$PR_BODY"
            echo "pr_number=$EXISTING_PR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
              --base main \
              --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
              --title "feat(docling-client): sync client with docling ${TAG}" \
              --body "$PR_BODY")
            echo "pr_number=$(echo "$PR_URL" | grep -oE '[0-9]+$')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post inline review comments on pull request diff
        if: steps.pr_create.outputs.pr_number != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ steps.pr_create.outputs.pr_number }}"

          if [ ! -f pr-comments.json ]; then
            echo "pr-comments.json not found — skipping inline comments."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Fetch the latest commit SHA on the PR branch (required by the API)
          COMMIT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.head.sha')

          # Post each comment via the GitHub REST API
          jq -c '.[]' pr-comments.json | while IFS= read -r comment; do
            PATH_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.path')
            LINE_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.line')
            BODY_VAL=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.body')

            gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              --method POST \
              --field commit_id="$COMMIT_ID" \
              --field path="$PATH_VAL" \
              --field line="$LINE_VAL" \
              --field side="RIGHT" \
              --field body="$BODY_VAL" \
              || echo "Warning: failed to post comment on $PATH_VAL:$LINE_VAL"
          done

name: Docling Core Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release (e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release:
    if: contains(vars.RELEASE_ACTORS, github.actor)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docling-core
    steps:
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        id: app-token
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.CI_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.CI_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docling-core/package-lock.json

      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run check

      - name: Bump version and tag
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          npm version "${{ inputs.version }}" --no-workspaces-update \
            --prefix docling-core --no-git-tag-version
          git add docling-core/package.json docling-core/package-lock.json
          git commit -s -m "chore(release): docling-core v${{ inputs.version }}"
          git tag "docling-core/v${{ inputs.version }}"
          git push --follow-tags

      - run: npm publish --provenance --access public

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: actions/github-script@v9
        with:
          script: |
            const version = '${{ inputs.version }}'.replace(/^v/, '');
            await github.rest.repos.createRelease({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              tag_name: `docling-core/v${version}`,
              name: `@docling/docling-core v${version}`,
              generate_release_notes: true,
            });

# Docling TS

TypeScript/JavaScript client for [docling-serve](https://github.com/docling-project/docling-serve) and interfaces for working with the JSON output format of [Docling](https://docling.ai).

## Docling Core

The [docling-core](docling-core) package matches the type definitions and utility functions of the [docling-core](https://github.com/docling-project/docling-core) library.

## Docling Client

The [docling-client](docling-client) package is the official TypeScript client
for Docling Serve and managed services implementing its API. It is modeled after
the official python client.

# Docling Components Web components for displaying Docling output, which simplifies document processing, parsing diverse formats — including advanced PDF understanding. This package requires the JSON output of documents that are converted by [Docling](https://docling.io). Get started with the [interactive examples](https://docling-project.github.io/docling-ts/examples). ## Install package In case of a client or single page application that is bundled upfront: ```sh npm i @docling/docling-components ``` Next, import the package at the application root to install the components: ```ts import '@docling/docling-components'; ``` In case of a static or server-side rendered website; add the package to the page HTML. Either download the package and serve it as part of the rest of the website, or use a CDN mirror of NPM: ```html ... ... ``` #### Item filter and highlight Narrow down the marked document items according to their reference path in the converted document: ```html ``` Select entire item categories with `items="#/pictures"`, full pages with `items="#/pages/2"`, and unions with `items="#/pictures, #/tables"`. Or select specific items programmatically: ```html ... ``` To emphasize item selections, you can suppress the non-selection into a page backdrop and/or trim out the pages without any selected items: ```html ``` #### Tooltip Pops up a tooltip besides an item when you hover it on a page. This tooltip shows the item's parsed content and annotations if matching web components are available: ```html ``` #### Overlay Overlays parsed content and annotations directly on top of items (potentially occluding them). ```html ``` ### docling-table This component displays the converted document as a table of parsed document items, with columns for item contents and an image from the rendered document (if available). #### Plain use ```html ``` You can select items with the `items` attributes, as described for the `docling-img` component. Selecting items will trim all non-selected items from view. #### Configure columns Select the columns that you want to have shown and in what order: ```html ``` You can use this to display the cropped image of a single document item as well: ```html ``` ## Item components Most types of document item have a prepackaged component that will be used to visualize it: | Tag | Item label | | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `` | checkbox_selected
checkbox_unselected
footnote
page_footer
page_header
paragraph
text
reference | | `` | table | You can use these tags directly with elements like `` to specify what components will be used, including optional parameters. For example, to exclusively show tooltips for table components: ``` ``` You can create your own item components by extending from the `DoclingItemElement` class at `/src/item/ItemElement.ts` and annotating the class with `@customDoclingItemElement('docling-my-first-item-component')` to have it registered as both a custom web element and as a default component for rendering document items. ## Annotation components Some types of document item annotation have a prepackaged component that will be used to visualize it: | Tag | Item label | Annotation kind | | ---------------------------------- | -------------------- | --------------- | | `` | chart
picture | classification | | `` | chart
picture | description | You can use these tags directly with elements like `` to specify what components will be used. For example, to overlay pictures with their classification, if any: ``` ``` You can create your own annotation components by extending from the `DoclingAnnotationElement` class at `/src/annotation/AnnotationElement.ts` and annotating the class with `@customDoclingAnnotationElement('docling-my-first-annotation-component')` to have it registered as both a custom web element and as a default component for rendering document annotations.
